title: Cusco Express
short_description: Discover Cusco and Machu Picchu on an intense 3-day, 2-night experience, ideal for seeing the essentials of the former Inca capital.
long_description:
Experience the magic of Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire. In only 3 days, discover some of the region's highlights and the world wonder of Machu Picchu.

This package is designed for travelers with limited time. It includes your arrival reception, time to acclimatize, a complete Machu Picchu excursion and your departure transfer.
price_note: Price per person for the Tours Only option. Prices are in US dollars.
seo_title: Cusco Express 3 Days / 2 Nights | Machu Picchu | GT Peru Travel
seo_description: Discover Cusco and Machu Picchu with the 3-day Cusco Express package, including transfers, train, admission and a professional guide.

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cusco and acclimatization
days.text:
We will meet you at Cusco Airport. This day is set aside to acclimatize in the Imperial City, located approximately 3,400 meters above sea level.

Among cobbled streets, impressive Inca walls and lively squares, you will find a city where past and present coexist. The afternoon is free to rest, acclimatize or enjoy optional activities.

days.title: Day 2: Machu Picchu
days.text:
We depart early for Ollantaytambo, where we board the tourist train to Aguas Calientes.

Our professional guide will meet us and lead us to the citadel of Machu Picchu. We tour its main sectors according to the assigned circuit.

After the visit, we return to Aguas Calientes and have free time before boarding the train to Ollantaytambo and continuing by tourist transportation to Cusco.

days.title: Day 3: Farewell and end of the trip
days.text:
The day remains available according to your flight departure time for shopping, walking around the city or additional activities.

Finally, we transfer you from your accommodation to Cusco Airport at the agreed time, concluding our services.

faq.pregunta: How far in advance should I book Cusco Express?
faq.respuesta: We recommend booking at least 30 days in advance. From May through August, booking 60 to 90 days ahead is advisable because Machu Picchu tickets and trains are in high demand.
The Tours Only option does not include accommodation. The 3-Star, Superior 3-Star and 4-Star Hotel categories include two nights with breakfast and taxes, according to the selected option.

faq.pregunta: Which services are included for Machu Picchu?
faq.respuesta: It includes Cusco–Ollantaytambo–Cusco transportation, Expedition or Voyager train, Consettur bus, Machu Picchu admission and an official Spanish- or English-speaking guide.
No. Domestic and international flights are not included. Travelers must arrive in Cusco independently, where our team provides reception and transfer.

faq.pregunta: Will I have time to acclimatize in Cusco?
faq.respuesta: Yes. The first day is reserved for arrival and acclimatization. We recommend resting, staying hydrated, eating lightly and avoiding intense physical activity.

faq.pregunta: Which Machu Picchu circuit is used?
faq.respuesta: The circuit depends on official availability when the booking is confirmed. Our team will select the best available option and provide the assigned time and circuit.

faq.pregunta: What should I bring to Machu Picchu?
faq.respuesta: Bring your original passport or ID, a small backpack, water, sunscreen, insect repellent, a hat, rain poncho and comfortable shoes. Train luggage allowance is limited.
Yes. We can adapt the hotel category, train type, private service and additional activities according to availability and budget.
